title: Cowboy chords room mic D Em G C 2x 140bpm Les Paul
sourceAudio: ../audio/Cowboy Chords Mic D Em G C D Em G C 140bpm LP.m4a
timingNotes: Onsets are the first sustained rise of each strum's attack, measured on a 1.5kHz-highpassed 1ms RMS envelope (threshold = local floor + 15% of the attack peak), cross-checked against the raw 2ms RMS waveform and a 1024/64 spectral-flux backtrack; the three methods agree within ~15ms on this take. Measured bar length runs 1617-1848ms around the 1714ms theoretical measure at 140bpm -- real strum timing, not a tempo change. Chord identity comes from FFT peak picking and a chroma template match on 16384-point windows taken 120ms after each attack; all eight are standard open-position voicings. No detector output was used to derive any value here. This is the room-mic capture of the same performance as the DI and amped files; it is a separate device, so it carries its own start offset of about +737ms relative to the DI (measured chord-by-chord, spread 728-749ms, which includes the acoustic path to the mic). Onsets 1-6 and 8 are measured on this file directly; onset 7 (13580ms) is taken from the DI plus the offset because the room decay of chord 6 masks its attack threshold here -- the raw envelope confirms a strum attack starting at 13582ms. The last chord rings until the strings are muted at ~16970ms.
